from fastapi import APIRouter
from uuid import uuid4

from .errors import ApiError
from .models import Run, RunSummary, RunCreate, ParticipantAction
from .store import run_store, run_summary_store

router = APIRouter(prefix="/runs")


@router.get("")
def list_runs():
    return list(run_summary_store.values())


@router.post("", status_code=201)
def create_run(body: RunCreate):
    if not body.title or not body.title.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "title is required and cannot be empty")
    if not body.datetime or not body.datetime.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "datetime is required and cannot be empty")
    if not body.meeting_location or not body.meeting_location.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "meeting_location is required and cannot be empty")

    run_id = str(uuid4())
    run = Run(
        id=run_id,
        title=body.title,
        datetime=body.datetime,
        meeting_location=body.meeting_location,
        distance=body.distance,
        pace_target=body.pace_target,
        route_notes=body.route_notes,
        participants=[],
    )
    run_store[run_id] = run
    run_summary_store[run_id] = RunSummary(
        id=run_id,
        title=run.title,
        datetime=run.datetime,
        meeting_location=run.meeting_location,
        participant_count=0,
    )
    return run


@router.get("/{run_id}")
def get_run(run_id: str):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run {run_id} not found")
    return run_store[run_id]


@router.post("/{run_id}/join")
def join_run(run_id: str, body: ParticipantAction):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run {run_id} not found")

    name = body.name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "participant name is required and cannot be empty")
    name = name.strip()

    run = run_store[run_id]
    if any(p.lower() == name.lower() for p in run.participants):
        raise ApiError("duplicate_participant", f"Participant '{name}' is already on this run")

    run.participants.append(name)
    run_summary_store[run_id].participant_count = len(run.participants)
    return run


@router.post("/{run_id}/leave")
def leave_run(run_id: str, body: ParticipantAction):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run {run_id} not found")

    name = body.name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "participant name is required and cannot be empty")
    name = name.strip()

    run = run_store[run_id]
    idx = next((i for i, p in enumerate(run.participants) if p.lower() == name.lower()), -1)
    if idx == -1:
        raise ApiError("participant_not_found", f"Participant '{name}' is not on this run")

    run.participants.pop(idx)
    run_summary_store[run_id].participant_count = len(run.participants)
    return run
